title: Pending Work Salvage Ledger — 2026-09-12
purpose: Track open/stale branches as provenance reservoirs, distinguish merge-ready work from salvage-only work, and prevent older branch merges from overwriting newer canonical owners.

disposition_vocabulary.already_on_main: The substantive work has landed on main directly or through a later equivalent/superseding change.
disposition_vocabulary.unique_port: A file/concept is absent from current main and should be transplanted onto a current-main branch.
disposition_vocabulary.merge_by_content: An old branch modifies an owner that has since changed; reconcile semantics/key sections rather than merge the old file wholesale.
disposition_vocabulary.superseded: Later work on main is more specific/current; keep old branch as provenance but do not re-promote its version.
disposition_vocabulary.defer_for_rebase: Large branch or UI/runtime change requires a dedicated current-main reconciliation/reimplementation pass.
disposition_vocabulary.historical_reservoir: Branch is too far behind for normal merging; use it as a source archive and salvage only demonstrably unique assets.

maintenance_law: An open PR is not evidence that its branch should be merged. Branch age, behind count, owner overlap, current canonical routing and unique information content determine whether to merge, port, reconcile or retain as provenance.
